name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are Not pc-Minor-Closed
statement: Every nonempty pc-minor is either another connected conditioning-minimal non-ample class or a UOMFib member. Both outcomes occur, so the class is not pc-minor-closed.
proof: Projections either preserve the connected minimal-non-ample layer or produce a cube. Any proper conditioning enters UOMFib, which is pc-minor-closed. Induction along elementary pc-minor operations gives the two-layer image. For $C_6$, a restriction is $P_3$ and a contraction is $C_4$, both UOMFib members outside the parent class.
